test_styler_to_latex: test the Styler.to_latex method generates valid LaTeX tabular output from a DataFrame
test_styler_to_latex_hrules: test the Styler.to_latex method with hrules=True generates \toprule, \midrule, and \bottomrule lines
test_styler_to_latex_longtable: test the Styler.to_latex method with environment=longtable generates a paginated longtable LaTeX output
test_styler_to_latex_multiindex: test the Styler.to_latex method with MultiIndex columns and rows generates \multicolumn and \multirow commands
test_styler_to_latex_siunitx: test the Styler.to_latex method with siunitx=True generates siunitx-formatted numeric columns
test_styler_to_latex_position: test the Styler.to_latex method with position parameter generates \begin{table}[position] wrapper
test_styler_to_latex_custom_styles: test the Styler.to_latex method with set_table_styles generates custom LaTeX commands like \mycommand
test_styler_to_latex_cell_styling: test the Styler.to_latex method with highlight_max generates styled cells with \itshape and \Huge commands
test_styler_to_latex_hide_index: test the Styler.to_latex method with hide(axis=index) omits the row index column from output
test_styler_to_latex_concat: test the Styler.concat method combines multiple stylers into a single LaTeX table with appended rows
test_styler_to_latex_map_index: test the Styler.map_index method applies formatting functions to index and column labels in LaTeX output
test_styler_to_latex_parse_cell_styles: test the _parse_latex_cell_styles function converts CSS-style cell style tuples to LaTeX wrapped commands
test_styler_to_latex_parse_css_conversio: test the _parse_latex_css_conversion function converts CSS color and font properties to LaTeX equivalents
test_styler_to_latex_parse_header_span: test the _parse_latex_header_span function generates \multicolumn or \multirow commands from header cell attributes
test_styler_to_latex_parse_table_styles: test the _parse_latex_table_styles function extracts custom selector props from table styles list
test_styler_to_latex_parse_table_wrappin: test the _parse_latex_table_wrapping function determines whether to wrap tabular in a table environment
test_styler_to_latex_clines: test the Styler.to_latex method with clines parameter generates \cline commands for multirow tables
test_styler_to_latex_short_caption: test the Styler.to_latex method with tuple caption generates \caption[short]{full} format
test_styler_to_latex_environment_option: test the Styler.to_latex method with environment parameter overrides the LaTeX environment name
